distribution.summary: 北京；福建；江西；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Beijing, Fujian, Jiangxi, Yunnan, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010), under Cyclorhipidion fukiensis, provides the first Taiwan record in that historical treatment; its broad China (SE) wording is not converted into province records. Lau (2025) provides additional Hong Kong checklist evidence. Lin & Smith (2022) independently records Taiwan, confirming the existing Taiwan assessment.

host_note: Cyclobalanopsis glauca (= Quercus glauca) and Quercus incana are retained from earlier reviewed sources. Lin & Smith (2022) adds no promoted host evidence for this taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion distinguendum (Eggers, 1930).

nomenclature_note: Current accepted identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Cyclorhipidion distinguendum (Eggers, 1930), VSN_1987. Beaver & Liu (2010) used Cyclorhipidion fukiensis as a new combination and synonymized Xyleborus tenuigraphus with C. fukiensis; these source-specific names and actions are retained as provenance under the current stable identity.
